verses.1: But you should speak about what is necessary in a healthy manner of teaching.
verses.2: They should be elderly men who are faithful, prudent, and who preserve their faith, love, and patience.
verses.3: It should be kept in a place that is suitable for religious purposes. It must not be exposed to light or alcohol. It must also be taught properly by qualified teachers.
verses.4: So that they can be careful to ensure that the new Philanders are indeed kind and gentle-hearted people.
verses.5: Rigid, honest, hardworking, kind-hearted, and willing to submit to the commands of individual men, so that the words of God are not slandered.
verses.6: He commands the younger ones to be prudent in the same way.
verses.7: Regarding everything related to yourself, it should be presented in a proper manner. In teaching, one must show purity and honesty.
verses.8: I understand that it’s not right to say anything bad about us, since he has nothing to say against us at all.
verses.9: Let them be under the management of private masters in all places. Let them live comfortably, without any problems.
verses.10: Not being deceived, but showing full faith in goodness, so that their teaching of the teachings of our Savior may be blessed in all places.
verses.11: For the divine grace of salvation has appeared to all people.
verses.12: Let us be taught to avoid disrespect and worldly desires. Let us live in this present age in a wise, just, and pious manner.
verses.13: Ready to embrace the wonderful hope and the glory of the great God, and our Savior Jesus Christ.
verses.14: He gave himself up for us, so that we might be freed from all sin and impurity, and so that he could purify his people through him. He was willing to do even the most difficult tasks.
verses.15: He spoke these things in a polite manner, and he also demanded that I be controlled under all conditions. Do not despise him at all.
